what: On phones the four stations stack into a column about 750px tall, so the station that lights up on each Next press is usually off screen while the finger is on the Next button about 1,100px further down. The reader has to scroll up and down on every step.

what: The active station changes its border from 3px to 5px, so every station box and everything inside it shifts by 2px each step, and the row jitters while Play runs.

what: Long code lines in the teller wrap back to the left margin, under the line numbers: `print("  (turns a` / `page)")` and `yield "a robot met a` / `loop."` lose their indent, so the wrapped half looks like a new, unindented line of Python.

panel: walkers with nested code (ch18 P25, ch19 P27, ch20 P5)
what: On phones the walker's code column is only about 12–20 characters wide once the Pip token gutter, line numbers and indentation are taken, so the hanging-indent wrapping breaks inside strings and dunder names (`print("befo` / `re")`, `__contain` / `s__`). The promise that 'a line breaks mid-word only when one token is longer than a whole line' doesn't hold, because at that width most tokens are longer than the line.
evidence: /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-py-16-20/a18/w390-044-p25.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-py-16-20/a19/w390-043-p27.png, /tmp/claude-0/-home-claude/7f030446-3270-51d4-abc1-d3638614f9af/scratchpad/review-visual-py-16-20/a20/w390-008-p5.png.
fix: At ≤640px: `.recipe { padding-left: 58px }` → `padding-left: 36px` with a smaller token, `tab-size: 2`, `font-size: 0.875rem`, and break only at spaces and the listed punctuation, falling back to sideways scroll (like `.term.wrap` long tokens) instead of `overflow-wrap: anywhere`.
